kurz: The more surface relative to size, the more crust and the faster it cooks.
bild_im_kopf: Crisps, chips, wedges, a whole baked potato: the same potato, but each time a different ratio of crust to soft inside.
was_passiert: Small or thin pieces have a lot of surface and little inside. They dry quickly, turn crisp and cook fast. Large pieces have a lot of soft inside. A roughened surface increases the area further without making the piece smaller.
faustregeln: Pieces of equal size cook evenly.
Roughing up brings crust without cutting smaller.

params.links: large and smooth: little crust, soft inside
params.rechts: small or rough: lots of crust, cooks fast
